decisions.reason: As the flagship of the organic line in a growing market and close to the core salami competence, the platter shows no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.

The organic poultry mini snack fits the strategic organic push, and the slack signalled by industry growth and hiring lets the firm carry it a while longer even though its snack-format results remain uncertain.
The premium sharing snack line is a low-cost extension of established salami expertise, and with no evidence of underperformance management keeps it rather than reallocate its resources.
The organic Fleischwurst was only recently launched, builds on a traditional core product and is actively promoted, so it is too early for any aspiration shortfall to justify dropping it.
The organic thin-sliced chicken breast line was launched in 2024 with several variants and fits the ingredient-conscious organic direction, so management would give it time to prove itself.
The organic herb-coated salami is a new variant close to core curing know-how with its own web page, so slack and strategic fit favour keeping it while results are still uncertain.
